purpose: Fit the bare polymer of the saved 20 Mb model to RAD21 2h-depleted mESC Fbn2 tracking, then test held-out conditions after explicit mechanistic changes.
model_scope: A coarse baseline candidate with the existing finite-rest bond, bending and soft-repulsion forces. It is not the published 70,000-monomer polychrom model and it does not reproduce all biology of RAD21 depletion.
resolution_rule: Compute each pair separately and report the 510/520 kb bracket; neither is exactly 515 kb. Do not silently average or relabel either curve as 515 kb.

alternative.warning: Changing beads per kb changes density, stiffness and friction per genomic length. The copied reduced mechanics are a starting candidate, not physically equivalent coarse-graining; never transfer the 10 kb clock.

workload.purpose: Provisional first long sampling workload with sufficient observations to assess local stationarity. Extend or redesign if convergence or the experimental lag window is not resolved.
workload.clock_unknown: Snapshot spacing of 4 reduced units has no known duration in seconds until fitting; re-sample finer if the trial clock fails to cover 60–1200 s.
workload.equilibration_caveat: Local 51/52-bead relaxation does not establish whole-chain equilibration. Global modes, confinement and initial-condition dependence can be much slower.
workload.disk_warning: The bundle creates 4001 full JSON snapshots per replica; inspect a pilot snapshot byte size before running four replicas.

acceptance_sequence: Run numerical acceptance checks on the selected compute node and verify actual platform metadata. Measure throughput before committing the full array.

Plot pair squared distance, radius of gyration, bond lengths and energy over reduced time for all independent seeds. Compare successive windows and multiple initial conformations; increase equilibration if means or distributions still drift.
Estimate autocorrelation and effective independent blocks from equilibrated pair-distance records. Use replica/block uncertainty, not overlapping MSD pair counts as independent observations.
Compute 3D full relative-vector MSD for both pair separations. Match exact lag window and noise convention; coordinates remain reduced. Keep nuclear-rotation treatment consistent.

Constrain length using the fit-subset mean squared pair distance after a declared observation-noise model. For a noise-free model compare E|R_sim|² with the corrected physical moment; length_nm=1000*sqrt(moment_um2/moment_sim). Retain uncorrected tutorial proxy only as a sensitivity comparison.

With length fixed, fit time_s against the fit subset over the stated window. Vary window and noise correction; reject incompatible curve shape. Quantify replica and acquisition uncertainty; do not claim a confidence interval from fit residuals alone.
Test the unused baseline acquisition holdout without refitting. Confirm distance distribution and MSD agree within declared tolerances; compare 510 versus520 kb brackets.
Repeat at smaller integration timestep and longer trajectories before accepting a biological clock. Explicitly test the alternative resolution if adopting5kb bins.

Keep accepted baseline length/time fixed for mechanistic perturbations. Fit cohesin or other mechanistic parameters against a designated training subset of perturbations and reserve the remaining conditions as new holdouts. Different experimental conditions never become interchangeable.
Calibrate protein diffusion, residence/binding and transcription parameters separately using their own observations. A shared clock only converts units.

commands.submit: After site-specific GPU/partition/account setup, extract baseline-20mb-10kb-cuda.zip, then submit its submit.slurm from the extracted directory.
commands.msd_510kb: python -m chromatin_studio.calibration msd --snapshots results/replica-0/snapshots.jsonl --beads 974,1025 --dimension 3 --observable relative_pair --drift-correction none --discard-before 8000 --output fbn2-510kb-msd.json
commands.msd_520kb: python -m chromatin_studio.calibration msd --snapshots results/replica-0/snapshots.jsonl --beads 974,1026 --dimension 3 --observable relative_pair --drift-correction none --discard-before 8000 --output fbn2-520kb-msd.json
commands.command_caveat: Discard8000 is a provisional analysis setting that must be supported by stationarity diagnostics, not an established equilibration time.
